verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a dedicated sandbox mode (pk1_sb_ key) that runs the full API against a simulated environment with fake credit, no real registry/DNS actions or charges, including signed webhooks, plus a zero-setup /mock mirror for exploring response shapes without any account — directly matching the story of testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the sandbox behaves as documented (only first-party docs cited).
